column1: # comment: Ingredients that never own a treatment indication on their own: they ship only as the enabling partner of another active moiety, so an INDICATION attributed to one of them is the partner's indication credited to the wrong component of a combination label (#88, FAILURE_MODES 5.4 wrong_pairing). Names are INNs and their salt forms; no upstream content is reproduced. Ritonavir is deliberately absent: it is both a pharmacokinetic booster and a treatment at full dose, and a name cannot tell the two apart. Contraindications on these drugs are real and are not affected by this list.
